clues: This city is the capital and the largest city of its state in Brazil. It serves as the seat of rule for the whole state round it.
Here, summer is the wettest and coldest time of the year. Hard rains and thick cloud cool the days when the sun should blaze most.
This city was founded in 1990, on old farm land. It was made to be the capital of a new state set up just two years before.
In 2002, a big dam on its river made a vast lake by the city. The lake gave this dry land city new beaches of its own.
A large straight avenue runs north to south through the city heart. Its shape copies a famed avenue in the nation's capital, Brasília.
